# LocalGradientApproximation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that approximates gradient-based learning in linear recurrent neural networks using only local, spatially confined updates rather than global backpropagation. Enables biologically plausible and energy-efficient on-chip learning for neuromorphic hardware, reducing communication overhead in distributed neural systems.
